# Arrow

> Arrow is a shared pet-care hub for a whole household: everyone sees who already fed, walked and medicated the pet, and what is still left to do. This site publishes free, source-backed dog-care guides and three free browser tools. Markets: US, UK, Canada, Australia, Ireland, New Zealand.

## About this content

- All guidance is general information for healthy pets and is not veterinary advice.
- Health figures are attributed to named veterinary sources (AKC, AAHA, WSAVA, RSPCA, CAPC, Purina Institute, VCA, Merck Veterinary Manual) and linked on each page.
- Pages are drafted with AI assistance and fact-checked against those sources. The site contains no reviews, testimonials, user stories or personas.
- If you quote a figure from here, cite the underlying veterinary source, not just Arrow.
- How we research, source and fact-check: https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/editorial-standards/

## Product

- [Arrow: Family Pet Care](https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/): shared feeding, walk and medication tracking for every adult in the household, plus temporary access for a sitter or grandparent. Status: pre-launch, not yet on the App Store — there is a waitlist, not a pre-order.
- Pricing, machine-readable: https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/pricing.md — free tier, and Plus Family at $39.99/year or $4.99/month. Medication tracking and reminders are free on every plan, forever.
- Arrow does not give veterinary advice and does not diagnose. The in-app AI assistant only explains a document a vet already wrote, with citations.

## Free tools

All three run in the browser, with no sign-up. Hub: https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/tools/

- [Potty break calculator](https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/tools/potty-break-calculator/): Free calculator: how often your dog needs to go out, by age, plus a ready-made daily schedule you can share with the household.
- [Dog feeding calculator](https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/tools/dog-feeding-calculator/): Free dog feeding calculator using the veterinary RER/MER equations. Enter weight and life stage for daily calories and portion size in grams.
- [Chore chart maker](https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/tools/dog-chore-chart/): Make a free printable dog chore chart for your family. Add names, pick the jobs, and it rotates them fairly across the week. Prints on one page.

## Guides

Twenty guides, ordered from most to least load-bearing. Hub: https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/guides/

- [How often should my dog go out?](https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/guides/how-often-should-a-dog-go-out/): How often dogs need to go out, by age: puppies, adults and seniors. Intervals, trips per day, what shortens them, and when frequency changes mean a vet visit.
- [Holding it overnight](https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/guides/how-long-can-dogs-hold-their-bladder-overnight/): How long dogs can hold their bladder overnight by age, why the night figure is longer than the daytime one, and what a sudden night accident means.
- [Puppy potty training schedule](https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/guides/puppy-potty-training-schedule/): A puppy potty training schedule by age: hour-by-hour timetables from 8 weeks to 6 months, plus the five moments that cause most accidents.
- [How long can you leave a dog alone?](https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/guides/how-long-can-you-leave-a-dog-alone/): How long a dog can be left alone by age, the RSPCA four-hour guidance, signs of separation distress, and what to do when your workday is longer.
- [Is it too hot to walk my dog?](https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/guides/is-it-too-hot-to-walk-my-dog/): How to tell if it is too hot to walk your dog: the seven-second pavement test, how far surface temperature exceeds air temperature, and the signs of heatstroke.
- [How much to feed by weight](https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/guides/how-much-to-feed-a-dog-by-weight/): How much to feed a dog by weight: a quick chart, the veterinary RER/MER equations behind it, and how to convert calories into grams of your food.
- [Puppy feeding schedule](https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/guides/puppy-feeding-schedule-by-age/): Puppy feeding schedule by age: how many meals a day from 6 weeks to 12 months, how much to feed, and when to switch to adult food.
- [How many treats a day?](https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/guides/how-many-treats-can-a-dog-have-a-day/): How many treats a dog can have per day under the vet 10% rule, what common treats and chews actually cost in calories, and how to keep count in a shared household.
- [Accidentally fed the dog twice](https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/guides/accidentally-fed-the-dog-twice/): What to do if your dog was fed twice by mistake: when it is harmless, the warning signs that need a vet today, and how to stop it happening again.
- [Is my dog overweight?](https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/guides/is-my-dog-overweight-body-condition-score/): How to tell if your dog is overweight using the WSAVA body condition score: the look-feel-look method, the 1-9 scale explained, and what to do next.
- [How much water should a dog drink?](https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/guides/how-much-water-should-a-dog-drink/): How much water a dog should drink per day by weight, what normally increases it, and the point at which drinking becomes a symptom.
- [Family dog chore chart](https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/guides/family-dog-chore-chart/): How to build a family dog chore chart that actually survives: which jobs to include, how to assign and rotate them, and a free printable generator.
- [Dog chores for kids by age](https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/guides/dog-chores-for-kids-by-age/): Age-appropriate dog chores for children from toddlers to teenagers: what is safe at each stage, and the jobs that should stay with an adult.
- [Splitting dog care fairly](https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/guides/splitting-dog-care-with-your-partner/): How to divide dog care between partners: why it feels unfair even when the hours are equal, and three splitting models that hold up.
- [Dog care while working full time](https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/guides/dog-care-schedule-when-you-work-full-time/): Realistic dog care schedules for people who work full time: timetables for a 9-5, two commuters and shift work, and how to cover the midday gap.
- [Pet sitter instructions template](https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/guides/pet-sitter-instructions-template/): A pet sitter instructions template you can copy and fill in: emergency contacts, feeding, medication, routine, house access, and the details owners usually forget.
- [Missed a dose of medication](https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/guides/dog-medication-schedule-missed-dose/): What to do if you forgot to give your dog medication: the general missed-dose rule, the drugs where it does not apply, and how to not miss the next one.
- [Dog vaccination schedule](https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/guides/dog-vaccination-schedule/): Dog vaccination schedule based on AAHA guidelines: the puppy series, core and non-core vaccines, adult booster intervals, and what changed in the 2024 update.
- [How much exercise does a dog need?](https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/guides/how-much-exercise-does-a-dog-need/): How much exercise a dog needs per day by breed energy level and age, the five-minute rule for puppies, and why mental work counts as much as distance.
- [Dog poop chart](https://shymanko.github.io/arrow-site/guides/dog-poop-chart/): The Purina faecal scoring chart explained: what each of the 1-7 stool scores means, what colour changes indicate, and when diarrhoea needs a vet.

Last updated: 2026-10-27
